notes:
- Cross-version foundation: the backend now knows which chapter and season a build belongs to (42 majors, Chapters 1-7) instead of assuming season == major, which was only ever true in Chapter 1.
- Per-build cosmetic keys: the keychain serves the right AES chunk keys for the requesting build (75 builds, 634 keys) rather than 7.40s to everyone.
- Distributed diagnostics: Cobalt and the match server now report structured failures, aggregated locally and forwarded by the launcher, with a ranked incident dashboard on the coordinator.
- Self-check fixes: four codes could never fire. NOVA-300/301/303/305 read the game log from the wrong folder entirely, and NOVA-307 grepped the wrong file. They work now.
- Port checks ask what is listening instead of only whether something is, so a leftover process no longer reads as healthy.
- A backend that cannot claim its port now exits loudly instead of running on with no HTTP surface.
- Security: session tokens forwarded by in-game components are redacted before they are stored or served.
